listing.name: Legacy Waving Banners
listing.summary: Replaces faction flags with animated waving banners and includes support for multiple modded factions and custom player flags.

description:
Legacy Waving Banners

Original forum thread

Notice of AcquisitionI got in touch with

Zer0morph

, he has been working under the name "Apostle Games" for 3.5 years as an indie developer on his next realease,

Age of Tribulation

(playtest currently available on steam). He kindly explained how to continue his mod and gave permission to take over.

Quote from: Zer0Morph on January 09, 2026, 01:03:49 PM

I AM...Zer0Morph, and I approve this message!  :o

Haha, well done Thecno! The new ones look fantastic and I'm honored you would carry the torch to the top of the mountain and allow me a seat at the table.
Thank you for doing this. God bless! 8)

[close]A mod that turns all faction flags into wavy banners. It includes all the vanilla factions, some modded ones and some custom flags for players to choose from. The flags were created manually using Photoshop (Zer0morph) or GIMP (me) and artistic adjustments have been made to ensure that the flags remain visible on dark backgrounds. To enable the replacement of modded faction flags, the mod must be loaded first as Starsector does not overwrite files that have already been added during modloading. I named it accordingly to do so, please do not rename the mod in mod_info.json.

New Features:

- New mod support

- New design philosophy : favours changing the black background to dark grey to avoid altering the colour patterns completely but Zer0morph's original flags remain unchanged.

- Alternative flag versions : for a look that is more faithful to the original colour scheme. To use these, locate the file in the "Legacy Waving Banners/graphics" folder, delete the standard flag, and rename "flag_alt.png" by removing the

"_alt"

suffix.

- Vanilla-only version: includes only vanilla factions and custom player flags (see download badges above).
